payload.core_mechanism_summary: Compute for each of Tommy's lanterns the max product with Banban's lanterns. Sort these per-lantern max values and output the second largest as the result of the minimax game.
payload.rationale: Tommy hides the lantern that yields the highest max product, so Banban gets the next best. Sorting the max values and picking second last simulates this. No custom comparator needed, but sorting is central.
